# storybook-addon-vis

> storybook-addon-vis: Storybook Vitest visual testing addon. Image snapshot testing for Vitest browser mode, with a Storybook integration. Documentation: https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/

This file is generated by `packages/storybook-addon-vis/scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs` from the packages' `exports` maps, their source, and the documentation pages. Do not edit it by hand; run `pnpm docs:llms` instead.

If an image snapshot test fails, read [Reviewing Failures with Agents](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/visual-testing/reviewing-failures-with-agents/) before opening any image. Without network access, read it from `node_modules/storybook-addon-vis/src/reviewing_failures_with_agents.mdx`.

Image snapshots are stored in the repository under `__vis__/`. Within it, `__baselines__` holds the expected images, `__results__` holds the images from the latest run, and `__diffs__` holds the diff images of failed comparisons. Next to each diff image, `<name>.review.png` is the review image of the changed regions and `<name>.regions.json` lists those regions.

Import from the entry points listed below, not from package internals. Documentation pages list the names they cover; names without a page have only their type declarations.

## Start here

- [storybook-addon-vis: Reviewing Failures with Agents](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/visual-testing/reviewing-failures-with-agents/): When an image snapshot fails, a coding agent often opens the baseline and the result and compares them.

## Packages

- [storybook-addon-vis](https://www.npmjs.com/package/storybook-addon-vis): Storybook Vitest visual testing addon. Peer dependencies: @storybook/addon-vitest ^10.1.10, @vitest/browser ^4, storybook ^10.1.10, vitest ^4.

## Visual testing concepts

- [What is visual testing](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/visual-testing/what-is-visual-testing/): What visual testing catches and misses, and the loop of writing, snapshotting, comparing, reviewing and updating.
- [How snapshots work](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/visual-testing/how-snapshots-work/): Baseline, result and diff images, the __vis__ folder layout, and what to commit and what to ignore.
- [Comparison and thresholds](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/visual-testing/comparison-and-thresholds/): How a result is compared with its baseline: pixel and SSIM methods, failure thresholds in pixels or percent, and how to choose.
- [Platforms and CI](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/visual-testing/platforms-and-ci/): Why baselines are kept per platform, how local runs differ from CI, and how to keep baselines current in CI.
- [Updating baselines](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/visual-testing/updating-baselines/): Create the first baselines and update them after an intended change, with createMissingBaseline, updateSnapshot and vitest -u.
- [Reviewing failures](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/visual-testing/reviewing-failures/): Read a failed image snapshot: the error message, the diff, the review image, the regions file, the Vis panel and git diff.
- [Variations](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/visual-testing/variations/): Take the same test in several themes, viewports and browsers, and when each one pays off.
- [Choosing a package](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/visual-testing/choosing-a-package/): Pick storybook-addon-vis for Storybook stories or vitest-plugin-vis for Vitest Browser Mode tests, and see how they relate.
